canonical_definition:
Space of definitions. In the available usage, papers treat this behavior as answering questions that can be resolved with a single piece of retrieved information. The only explicit formulation also labels these as 'simple single-hop tasks.'

Variants. Beyond the label 'simple single-hop tasks,' the papers do not name additional sub-tasks, domains, or modalities for this behavior.

Space of elicitation and scores. No measurement instrument is linked to this behavior in the papers, so no elicitation or scoring instrument is specified.

What it is taken as evidence of. The papers do not link this behavior to any broader construct as evidence of.
